extraction.notes: Quarter is three months ended Dec 31, 2024 (first column). Amounts in thousands. Two line items printed as dashes for Q4 2024 (Gain on sale of non-depreciable real estate assets, Gain on debt extinguishment, Mark-to-market debt adjustment is also a dash) are recorded at 0; the Mark-to-market line is actually shown as '—' for 2024 Q4. Gain on investments is net of tax. Gain on consolidation of third-party development is categorized as 'nareit_other' since it has no closer category; it is in the FFO section. Diluted FFO share count 119,958 thousand reproduces FFO $2.21, Core FFO $2.23, Core AFFO $2.03 per share. The AFFO section subtracts recurring capex, so recurring_capex_disclosed is null.
